message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie content can vary slightly depending on size and variety:

| Size (approx.) | Weight | Calories |
|----------------|--------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)  | 90 g   | ~18 kcal |
| Medium (≈123 g)| 123 g  | ~22 kcal |
| Large (≈182 g) | 182 g  | ~32 kcal |

So, if you’re eating a typical medium tomato, you’re looking at about 20–25 kcal.
